panels.general_description: Two grayscale cross-sectional CT-style images of the neck and upper chest, each with a white arrow, side by side.
panels.detailed_description: The image is two grayscale images separated by a thin white vertical band. The left image is a coronal-style view of the neck with the skull base and orbits at the top, a central column of bright cervical vertebrae, soft-tissue neck on both sides and the upper chest at the bottom. A long white arrow in the lower left points up and to the right toward a curved band of gray soft tissue at the base of the neck, above the dark lung apex. A small white arrowhead is cut off at the upper left corner. The right image is an axial-style slice at the level of the thoracic inlet, with bright vertebral body and posterior elements at the bottom center, bright clavicular and rib or sternal structures at the upper left and upper right, and dark lung fields at both sides. A dark round air-filled structure with a small bright-rimmed lumen lies near the center. A white arrow at the lower left of center points up and to the right toward a gray soft-tissue structure beside and behind this air-filled structure. No panel letters, text, scale or other labels are visible.

visual.general_description: Author-created color anatomical illustration of arteria lusoria and the non-recurrent laryngeal nerve with printed labels.
visual.detailed_description: Figure 3 is a single labeled color illustration of the thyroid, airway, aorta and its branches, the vagus nerve and a short branch labeled NRLN, with a long curved vessel labeled Arteria Lusoria. Eight printed labels with leader lines are the only text.

panels.general_description: Color anatomical illustration of the neck and upper mediastinum with labeled nerves, thyroid, aorta and arteries.
panels.detailed_description: Color illustration on a white background. A long vertical yellow nerve at the left, labeled Vagus, runs the height of the drawing with a short horizontal yellow branch, labeled NRLN, leaving it near the top and running to the right toward the thyroid. A mauve butterfly-shaped thyroid, labeled Thyroid, sits at the top center above a gray ribbed tube (the trachea and its branches), and gray ribbed tubes also extend down and to the lower left and right. A large red-brown aorta, labeled Aorta, forms an arch at the center with branches: a vessel labeled Right Common Carotid Artery rising toward the upper left, one labeled Left Common Carotid Artery rising to the upper right, one labeled Left Subclavian Artery to the right, and a long curved vessel labeled Arteria Lusoria that arises from the far side of the arch, curves across behind the gray tube and extends to the left, ending in short stubs at the left beyond the vagus. Each label sits at the edge of the drawing with a thin black leader line and arrowhead. The descending aorta continues downward at the bottom center. No caption text beyond the labels is printed in the image.
